rationale: This chaincode contains standard HLF transaction entrypoints (Init/Invoke) with three functions: initParty, readParty, and transferPoints. None of the vulnerability patterns are present: no time.Now() (C1), no goroutines (C2), no map iteration (C3), no rich queries like GetQueryResult (C4), and no package-level mutable state (C6). All operations use deterministic GetState/PutState with explicit keys and json.Marshal on structs (not maps).
